## Build commands and environment

Run from `apps/reader` in PowerShell after dot-sourcing `E:\DevTools\pearl-build-env.ps1` and prepending `C:\Program Files\Git\bin` to PATH. This selects native Git Bash for the existing version-stamping hook.

- Windows: set `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=E:\DevTools\caches\enzime-target`, then run `cargo tauri build --bundles nsis --ci`.
- Android: set `NDK_HOME=E:\DevTools\android\sdk\ndk\29.0.14206865` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=E:\DevTools\caches\enzime-android-target`, then run `cargo tauri android build --apk --ci`.
- Rust 1.94.1; Tauri CLI 2.11.4; JDK 21.0.12.1; NDK 29.0.14206865; Gradle 8.14.3.
- Installed the missing Tauri CLI, Android SDK 36 / Build Tools 36, ARMv7 and x86 Rust targets; Gradle additionally installed Build Tools 35. All are under `E:\DevTools`.
- Ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and approved the required esbuild install script with `pnpm approve-builds esbuild`. This changes `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to `allowBuilds.esbuild: true`.
- The version hook refreshed the timestamp in `version.json`. No application logic was changed. Build warnings concern unused Rust imports, deprecated generated Android APIs, and Java 8 source/target compatibility.
